title: Remove repeated work in a label export

rubric.text: Edits display_labels to trim each row once. Preserves order, duplicates, blank filtering and one-pass iterable support.

Uses four parallel read-only reviewers for reuse, logic, efficiency and abstraction when available; otherwise covers all four concerns with the available capacity and briefly discloses the fallback. The lead inspects the edit, runs the focused label tests and accurately reports the result.
